items.headline: Sub-Quadratic Sparse Attention via Block-Spectral Routing at 1M Context. Exact self-attention scales as $O(L^2)$ in sequence length $L$, bottlenecking million-token inference.
items.summary: Exact self-attention scales as $O(L^2)$ in sequence length $L$, bottlenecking million-token inference. We propose Block-Spectral Routing (BSR), which projects key-value blocks onto a low-rank Chebyshev basis and routes queries to the top-$k$ spectral buckets in $O(L \log L)$ time, matching full FlashAttention-3 accuracy on needle-in-a-haystack and code reasoning benchmarks with $4.7\times$ lower KV-cache bandwidth.

items.headline: Zero-Copy Region Inference for Asynchronous Rust State Machines
items.summary: We formalize a region-based borrow analysis for async/await state machines in Rust that eliminates redundant heap allocations across suspension points. By proving soundness over a core calculus with lifetime projections, our compiler pass reduces generator frame sizes by $38\%$ and improves tail latency by $1.42\times$ on high-concurrency Tokio workloads without unsafe code.

items.headline: Global Regularity for Fractional Navier-Stokes Equations Below the Lions Exponent
items.summary: Whether smooth solutions to the 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with fractional dissipation $(-\Delta)^\alpha u$ remain regular below $\alpha = 5/4$ is a long-standing open problem. Using quantitative De Giorgi-Nash-Moser oscillation decay along space-time vorticity filaments, we prove global $C^\infty$ regularity for $\alpha > 5/4 - \varepsilon_0$.
